messages:
alex: FYI onboarding partner CloudFab sent session-aggregated usage (one row per session). EU totals look inflated.
maria: sample payload? can they provide per-request rows? :thinking_face:
sam: redacted sample:
{
  "partner_id": "cloudfab-23",
  "session_id": "s-ghi555",
  "start": "2026-03-22T08:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-03-22T08:25:00Z",
  "tokens_used": 7500,
  "sku": "cf-pro"
}
sam: they send totals per session; our billing/entitlements and SKU mapping expect per-call granularity.
june: region field missing too. wrong region => wrong VAT/credits.
ops_lead: confirmed most appear to be eu-central, which impacts taxes and partner payouts.
alex: short-term: ingestion will split sessions into synthetic calls using sku_avg_tokens, mark synthetic=true so reconciliation can trace them.
maria: ok short-term but we need a contract/schema update for deterministic mapping and auditability.
billing-bot: ingest-warning partner=cloudfab-23 field=region missing
sam: medium-term: require call_count or request_list + optional per-call timestamps; long-term: partner profile flag for aggregated payload acceptance.
june: add metric percent_tokens_synthetic per-partner + alert at >5%.
alex: timeline: hotfix by EOD tomorrow. sam to PR; june to add dashboard metric; alex to schedule partner call.
maria: ops SQL for quick audit:
SELECT partner_id, session_id, SUM(CASE WHEN synthetic='t' THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) AS synthetic_tokens, SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens FROM billing_events WHERE partner_id='cloudfab-23' AND created_at >= '2026-03-22' GROUP BY partner_id, session_id;
sam: will include e2e test verifying totals reconcile when partner supplies per-call rows.
alex: add console banner "Partner usage shape heuristic applied" + partner docs link for transparency (48h).
maria: action items: sam implement hotfix + tag (due 2026-03-25); june add metric/alert (due 2026-03-26); alex schedule partner call (2026-03-24 10:00 PT); ops_lead update recon playbook for retro conversions (due 2026-03-27).
maria: keeping thread open; will post PR and partner notes here.
